name: Trospium pivotal trials
question: Does immediate-release trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily improve overactive bladder symptoms compared with placebo over 12 weeks?

design.population: 523 patients with overactive bladder and urge incontinence entered the primary study at 51 sites.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled phase III randomized trial
design.locator: Zinner 2004, PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results

verdictNote: Both coprimary symptom counts improved versus placebo over 12 weeks.
takeaway: In the Zinner phase III trial, trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily reduced daily toilet voids and urge incontinence episodes more than placebo over 12 weeks.

reports.label: Zinner placebo-controlled trial
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation, June 2004; day not reported
reports.citation: Zinner N, Gittelman M, Harris R, et al. "Trospium Chloride Improves Overactive Bladder Symptoms: A Multicenter Phase III Trial." *J Urol.* 2004;171(6 Pt 1):2311-2315. doi:10.1097/01.ju.0000127742.73136.0c
reports.followUp: 12 weeks; effects reported by week 1 and sustained through week 12
reports.followUpLocator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results

results.measure: Change in average toilet voids per 24 hours over 12 weeks
results.note: The abstract reports a significant decrease versus placebo without arm-specific changes, an effect estimate, or a P value.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results

results.measure: Change in urge incontinent episodes per 24 hours over 12 weeks
results.note: The abstract reports a significant decrease versus placebo without arm-specific changes, an effect estimate, or a P value.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods and Results

results.measure: Change in nocturnal urinations by week 4
results.note: The abstract reports a significant decrease by week 4 without a magnitude.
The abstract reports improvement at week 12 without a score or between-group estimate.

delivery.label: Oral treatment
delivery.value: Trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily or placebo for 12 weeks, randomized 1:1.

reports.label: Separate Rudy phase III trial
reports.dateLocator: PubMed citation, February 2006; day not reported
reports.citation: Rudy D, Cline K, Harris R, et al. "Multicenter Phase III Trial Studying Trospium Chloride in Patients with Overactive Bladder." *Urology.* 2006;67(2):275-280. doi:10.1016/j.urology.2005.08.017
reports.followUp: 658 patients randomized at 52 sites; 12-week treatment, with effects reported at weeks 1, 4, and 12

results.note: The abstract reports a significant decrease versus placebo at weeks 1, 4, and 12 without arm-specific changes or a P value.

results.measure: Change in daily urge urinary incontinence episodes
results.note: The abstract reports a significant decrease versus placebo at weeks 1, 4, and 12 without a magnitude.

harms.label: Dry mouth and constipation
harms.note: Reported adverse events; the abstract gives no arm-specific incidence or severity.

delivery.value: Trospium chloride 20 mg twice daily or placebo for 12 weeks, randomized 1:1.
